A FEW THINGS THAT SHAPED ME
an.
Engineer’s curiosity ↗Founder’s ownership ↗Operator’s follow-through ↗
IIT HyderabadM.Tech · Techno-Entrepreneurship
2023–25 / 9.11 CGPA

I’m Abhishek, a builder working at the intersection of product, strategy and operations. My background runs from mechanical engineering to techno-entrepreneurship at IIT Hyderabad, with a common thread: understanding how things work, and finding a better way forward.

At Aivana Health Intelligence, that has meant listening to doctors, hospitals and students, designing AI-assisted workflows, and testing ideas in the field. I’m drawn to the space between an open-ended question and a concrete product decision. Research, requirements and pilot metrics help me make that space navigable.

My work in the founder’s office at Dyadic Health brought another perspective: even a promising idea needs an operating rhythm. Clear trackers, useful dashboards and well-defined next steps can give a growing team the room to move.

I care about practical systems, thoughtful technology and evidence that survives contact with the real world. Beyond product and operations, I’ve led the IIT Hyderabad Cricket Club and helped organise a league for more than 100 players across five teams. Building something people want to be part of matters to me, on and off the field.

I’m interested in product, founder’s office, strategy and operations opportunities where curiosity can become useful work.
